findings.claim: Resolved during gate: functional key names could leak as associated text.
findings.evidence: Added exact Enter and ArrowUp vectors in kitty-keys.test.ts.

findings.claim: Resolved during gate: browser-owned keydown paths could emit orphan Kitty releases.
findings.evidence: Added suppressed keyup tracking plus shortcut, composition, and stale-suppression regressions.

findings.claim: Resolved during gate: built-in push and pop extra-parameter behavior diverged from Ghostty.
findings.evidence: Matched Ghostty defaults and added a Zig regression.

findings.claim: Resolved during gate: keypad Enter and NumLock-off navigation lost keypad identity.
findings.evidence: Added NumpadEnter and code:key navigation mappings with exact vectors.
findings.layer: browser key identity to protocol bytes

findings.claim: Resolved during gate: older custom WASM binaries could crash on missing Kitty exports.
findings.evidence: Adapters now default missing exports to zero; both cores have regressions.

findings.claim: Cross-family candidate: the built-in eight-entry stack should stop rather than wrap.
findings.evidence: The accepted Solution Gate executed wrap and oversized-pop behavior against pinned Ghostty 1.3.1; the built-in regression preserves that parity contract.

findings.claim: Cross-family candidate: repeats emit event-type suffixes without KITTY_REPORT_EVENTS.
findings.evidence: encodeKittyKey sets eventType to zero unless KITTY_REPORT_EVENTS is negotiated, so repeat encodes as a press-compatible sequence.

findings.claim: Cross-family candidate: adding CSI private markers '<' and '=' changes unrelated dispatch.
findings.evidence: Both markers are routed only when final is 'u'; no other csi_private consumer handles or observes them.
